title: Verify homepage load and primary navigation
steps: Verify that the 'custom logo link' is visible in the header.
Click the 'Who We Are' link in the navigation menu.
Click the 'Services' link in the navigation menu.
Click the 'Contact Us' link in the navigation menu.
expected: The page navigates or scrolls to the respective sections for 'Who We Are', 'Services', and 'Contact Us'.
intent: Ensures the homepage is accessible and core navigation links direct the user to the correct sections.
whyItMatters: If the main navigation fails, visitors cannot find information about your services or team, making the site a dead end.

title: Submit contact form with all required fields empty
steps: Click the 'Submit' button to send the form.
expected: The form is not submitted and a validation error appears near the 'Email *' field.
intent: Proves that the contact form requires an email address before allowing a submission.
whyItMatters: If this fails, you might receive empty inquiries with no way to reply to the potential client.
checklistTitle: Submit with all required fields empty

title: Successful contact form submission
steps: Type 'Interested in Salesforce consulting.' into the 'Comment or Message' field.
expected: The form displays a success message confirming the message was sent.
intent: Validates that a complete form submission triggers a success state.
whyItMatters: This is the primary way new business reaches you; if it breaks, you lose leads and revenue.

title: Contact form with malformed email address
expected: The browser or the site displays an error message indicating the email format is invalid.
intent: Ensures the email field only accepts valid email formats.
whyItMatters: If people enter typos in their email addresses and the site accepts them, you won't be able to reach them back.

title: Newsletter subscription with valid email
steps: Scroll to the 'Join our Newsletter' section in the footer.
Type 'subscriber@example.com' into the 'Enter your e-mail address' field.
expected: The user is redirected or shown a confirmation that they have subscribed.
intent: Verifies the newsletter sign-up process works for marketing purposes.
whyItMatters: Newsletters help you stay in touch with your audience; if this breaks, your marketing list stops growing.
